verdict.rationale: Consensus documents search, screen, extract, and synthesize workflows with study-type filters, PICO extraction, and Deep Searches/Lit Reviews across many studies, which supports systematic screening/extraction at scale. However, all evidence is vendor-claimed docs with no independent or hands-on validation of consistency/rigor across large batches, and no evidence of exportable structured screening criteria or reproducible inter-study consistency checks. Missing for 10: independent verification of extraction consistency across many papers, hands-on evidence of systematic screening at scale, and detail on customizable screening criteria templates.
